sub: UAE — joined BRICS Jan 1, 2024; major global trade and financial hub bridging East and West

label: Kazan

label: Rio de Janeiro
sub: 17th BRICS Summit — July 6-7, 2025; AI governance declaration and Global South reform agenda

label: NDB Shanghai
sub: New Development Bank HQ — opened Jul 2015; $42.9B+ approved (140+ projects by Q1 2026); 30% local currency lending target by end-2026

label: Riyadh
sub: Saudi Arabia — invited to join BRICS Aug 2023; froze membership bid late 2024; hedging between BRICS and US ties

label: Ankara
sub: Turkey — admitted as BRICS Partner Country at Kazan Oct 2024; NATO member seeking multi-vector diplomacy

label: Thiruvananthapuram
sub: BRICS Employment Working Group — 2nd meeting, May 6–7, 2026; part of India's 2026 chairmanship working-group calendar

label: New Delhi (2026 Chair)
sub: 18th BRICS Summit — September 12–13, 2026; FM Meeting May 14–15 ended without joint statement due to Iran-UAE confrontation; India chairs under 'Building for Resilience, Innovation, Cooperation and Sustainability'

label: NDB Annual 2026
sub: NDB 11th Annual Meeting of the Board of Governors — May 14–15, 2026, Moscow; theme: 'Development Financing in an Era of Technological Revolution'; first NDB annual meeting held in Russia

label: Tashkent
sub: Uzbekistan — NDB member from May 22, 2026; BRICS Partner Country since Kazan 2024; first Central Asian NDB member; $5B project pipeline in irrigation, mining, infrastructure

label: Harare
sub: Zimbabwe — NDB membership accession negotiations began May 2026; NDB Board authorised talks May 15; would be first sub-Saharan African NDB member beyond SA and Egypt

label: Pretoria
sub: South Africa — NDB approved up to $1B loan (June 17, 2026) for urban infrastructure across 8 metros under the PUIMM programme

label: Nagpur
sub: 3rd BRICS Transport Ministers' Meeting — July 11, 2026; adopted joint declaration on logistics, decarbonisation, and the BRICS Railway Research Network

label: Shanghai (NDB HQ)
sub: NDB Board appointed 2 new Vice-Presidents (July 8) and priced a $1.75B 3-year bond, 1.8x oversubscribed (July 17, 2026)

label: Hyderabad
sub: 2nd BRICS Anti-Corruption Working Group & Expert Network on Asset Recovery — August 4-5, 2026; final anti-corruption meeting under India's 2026 presidency

label: Jaipur
sub: 16th Trade Ministers' + 10th Industry Ministers' Meeting — Aug 6-7, 2026; adopted Jaipur Consensus; Goyal rejected a BRICS common currency

label: Rio de Janeiro
sub: UnionPay-Pix cross-border QR payment pilot launched Aug 4, 2026 by UnionPay International and the Chinese Consulate General — concrete step toward BRICS local-currency payment interoperability

label: Udaipur
sub: Meeting of Heads of BRICS Competition Authorities — Aug 8, 2026; adopted joint statement on fair competition in renewable-energy markets

label: New Delhi (Environment Ministers)
sub: 12th BRICS Environment Ministers' Meeting — Aug 17-18, 2026; adopted cooperation priorities on sustainable lifestyles, afforestation, circular economy, and climate adaptation

label: Chennai (STI Ministers)
sub: 14th BRICS Science, Technology & Innovation Ministerial — Chennai Declaration adopted Aug 21, 2026

label: Jaipur (Tourism Ministers)
sub: BRICS Tourism Ministers adopt the Jaipur Declaration, Aug 21, 2026

label: Visakhapatnam (Youth & Sports Ministers)
sub: BRICS Youth Ministers' Meeting (Aug 22) and Sports Ministers' Meeting (Aug 23), 2026
